text.tspan: What we test, where and when
Each layer is slower and closer to the real thing than the one before. A failure goes back to the repo that owns it.
every push to a PR, in each repo
GitHub runners: no AWS, no other repos
one repo broken on its own
what only breaks in the cloud
The cross-repo tests (smoke, jobs, browser) are owned by this control repo. They are changed here on purpose, never weakened to make a run pass.
